title: Cyllene 080/067 SR Japanese Pokemon Full Art Supporter Shimaboshi nagimiso
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Cyllene (Shimaboshi) – Japanese Pokemon Trainer – 080/067 SR
You will receive the exact card pictured. These are photos of the actual card, not stock images. Front, back, and close-ups of all four corners are shown.
Card details
Name: Shimaboshi / Cyllene
Card type: Trainer – Supporter
Set: Battle Region (s9a), 2022
Card number: 080/067
Rarity: SR (Super Rare) – full art
Illustrator: nagimiso
Regulation mark: F
Copyright: © 2022 Pokemon / Nintendo / Creatures / GAME FREAK
Language: Japanese
Card text (translated):
Flip 2 coins. For each heads, choose a card from your discard pile, show it to your opponent, and put them on top of your deck in any order.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
Note for collectors: this is an SR (Super Rare) full-art Supporter. The card number 080 runs past the 067 main set, so this is a secret rare that only appears beyond the numbered set. Full-art Supporters use textured foil with the artwork extending across the entire card, and character Supporters like this one are collected by trainer-card collectors as well as players. Cyllene is the Galaxy Team Survey Corps captain from Pokemon Legends: Arceus.
Condition: Ungraded, in the condition shown. Please review all photos closely and judge for yourself – the images are of the actual card and are the most accurate description of its condition. Corner close-ups are included so you can assess edge and corner wear directly. Textured full-art foil shows handling marks more readily than standard cards, so please review the photos carefully.
